To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a MLSPCMS design with a high melting PCM in the top, sensible concrete in middle, and a low melting PCM in the bottom of the TES tank is the best alternative to the two-tank molten salt system in terms of annual performance.
the annual performance of a cascaded or multi layered shell and tube TES system is highly sensitive to the operational conditions of other CSP components.
the cascaded PCMs are the most promising alternative storage material for CSP systems and that MLSPCMs can be designed to achieve the performance of the conventional two tank systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the performance of the TES system integrated into the whole CSP plant and is the first study to compare the performance of various TES designs integrated with a CSP plant.
the performance of the storage system as part of the integrated system and is not concerned with the performance or characteristics of the storage material itself.

the development of a novel TES design for CSP systems which is able to store and deliver thermal energy at a high efficiency, and is able to operate under the real time operational conditions of the CSP plant.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cascaded PCM designs are a good alternative to the conventional two tank storage system, and the multi layered PCM design can be an even better alternative.
the MLSPCM designs are the best alternatives to the two tank system in terms of annual energy performance.
the MLSPCM design alternative with the best annual performance was found to be 5% less efficient than the two tank system under real time operational constraints.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, in the context of CSP plants, the cascaded PCMs offer a potentially viable alternative to the conventional molten salt system, but the MLSPCM design is the most promising alternative.
the shell and TES alternatives can be competitive to the molten salt two tank systems under extended operating conditions and that the MLSPCMs can be a promising alternative to the cascaded PCMs.
the cascaded PCM design alternatives are promising and that MLSPCMs are the most attractive alternative for CSP applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance of the storage system depends not only on the storage media, but also on the interactions between the storage media and other components in the CSP system.

a well designed cascaded PCM or MLSPCM system, integrated with other CSP plant components, can approach the performance of a conventional two tank system, while requiring significantly less storage volume.
the design of a TES system should not be done in isolation from the design of the rest of the CSP plant.
